title: Unistationarity of Type II_l autocatalytic cores
summary: We prove unistationarity of reversible Type II_l autocatalytic cores with l at least three under strictly positive degradation. The source-minimal wiring forces source exhaustion and unit return tails, allowing comparison of positive stationary states through current ratios, chain reduction and a cyclic determinant argument. The proof includes separated stems and the exceptional coincident three-fork branch, with all internal chain species retained.
